description: This file defines the AppEntry class, which models a launcher activity entry in an Android application, encapsulating label, icon, and launch intent information.

classes.name: AppEntry
classes.description: Represents a single launchable activity with associated label, icon, and intent.

methods.name: AppEntry
methods.description: Constructor initializing AppEntry with ResolveInfo and PackageManager, setting label, icon, and launch intent.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the app entry.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon drawable of the app entry.

methods.name: getLaunchIntent
methods.description: Returns the intent used to launch the app.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Retrieves the component name associated with the launch intent.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the label as string representation of AppEntry.
